ti: knowledge extraction is LLM-driven end to end, including from repos with no records at all
knowledge: LLM-authored entries, resolved conflicts, ADR options, all prose sections

note: Knowledge pipeline is LLM-driven end to end. NewEntry takes no key parameter at all, so a caller structurally cannot break dedup; verified its key equals the key Extract computes for the same text, which is what lets LLM-authored and extracted entries merge. Provenance splits asserted-by from derived-from. Conflict resolutions persist with the losing values intact. ADR options travel via a new item.ParseOptions; its body is byte-identical to decideOptions, confirmed by diff, and removing that duplication from decide.go is the named follow-up. All whitelisted prose sections travel. Known limitation the implementer flagged: every prose section maps to one kind, so two differently-named sections with identical text collide into one entry.
